ja: • 『鉄血のオルフェンズ』第2期の主人公機「ガンダム・バルバトスルプス」が、フルメカニクスシリーズで立体化！
• 全高約180mmのボディに、メカデザインを担当する鷲尾直広氏が描き下ろすメカニカル感あふれるディテールを追加！
• ガンダム・フレームを細部まで再現し、劇中再現も容易に可能！
• 多彩なギミックを備えた各種武装も付属し、どんなポージングも見栄えよく決まる！
en: • The main character of the second season of "Iron-Blooded Orphans", "Gundam Barbatos Lupus", is now three-dimensional in the Full Mechanics series!
• Mechanical details drawn by Naohiro Washio, who is in charge of mechanical design, have been added to the body with a total height of approximately 180mm!
• The Gundam frame is reproduced down to the last detail, making it easy to recreate it from the movie!
• Various weapons with various gimmicks are also included, making any pose look great!
